payment_query_due_idx.name: payment_query_due_idx
payment_query_due_idx.where: "payment"."status" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'AWAITING_DEPOSIT') OR ("payment"."status" IN ('FAILED', 'APPROVED') AND "payment"."next_query_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_next_query_check.name: payment_next_query_check
payment_next_query_check.value: "payment"."status" NOT IN ('UNKNOWN', 'AWAITING_DEPOSIT') OR "payment"."next_query_at" IS NOT NULL
